title: Ensure the log destinations are set correctly
rationale: PostgreSQL should write logs to a supported destination to ensure audit records are captured.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_destination = 'stderr';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure the logging collector is enabled
rationale: The logging collector captures server log output into log files for auditing and troubleshooting.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET logging_collector = 'on';
Restart PostgreSQL.

title: Ensure the log file destination directory is set correctly
rationale: Logs should be written to a dedicated directory with appropriate permissions.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_directory = 'log';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure the filename pattern for log files is set correctly
rationale: Log filenames should follow a predictable naming convention to simplify management.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_filename = 'postgresql-%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S.log';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure the log file permissions are set correctly
rationale: Restrict log file access to prevent unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_file_mode = '0600';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure log_truncate_on_rotation is enabled
rationale: Truncating rotated log files prevents uncontrolled log growth.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_truncate_on_rotation = 'on';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure the maximum log file lifetime is set correctly
rationale: Log rotation prevents excessively large log files.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_rotation_age = '1d';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure the maximum log file size is set correctly
rationale: Limiting log file size prevents uncontrolled disk usage.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_rotation_size = '100MB';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure the correct syslog facility is selected
rationale: Using a dedicated syslog facility simplifies log routing and monitoring.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET syslog_facility = 'LOCAL0';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure syslog messages are not suppressed
rationale: Sequence numbers help detect missing or reordered syslog messages.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET syslog_sequence_numbers = 'on';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure syslog messages are not lost due to size
rationale: Splitting large syslog messages helps prevent message truncation by syslog daemons.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET syslog_split_messages = 'on';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure the program name for PostgreSQL syslog messages is correct
rationale: A consistent program identifier simplifies log filtering and monitoring.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET syslog_ident = 'postgres';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure the correct messages are written to the server log
rationale: Recording important server messages assists in monitoring and troubleshooting.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_min_messages = 'warning';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure the correct SQL statements generating errors are recorded
rationale: Logging SQL statements that generate errors supports auditing and incident investigations.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_min_error_statement = 'error';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure debug_print_parse is disabled
rationale: Parse tree debugging should be disabled in production environments.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET debug_print_parse = 'off';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure debug_print_rewritten is disabled
rationale: Rewritten query debugging should be disabled in production environments.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET debug_print_rewritten = 'off';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure debug_print_plan is disabled
rationale: Execution plan debugging should be disabled in production environments.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET debug_print_plan = 'off';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure debug_pretty_print is enabled
rationale: Pretty printing improves the readability of debug output when debugging is enabled.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET debug_pretty_print = 'on';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure log_connections is enabled
rationale: Connection logging provides an audit trail of successful client connections.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_connections = 'all';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure log_disconnections is enabled
rationale: Logging client disconnections provides a complete audit trail of database sessions.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_disconnections = 'on';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure log_error_verbosity is set correctly
rationale: The default verbosity level provides sufficient error information without exposing unnecessary implementation details.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_error_verbosity = 'default';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure log_hostname is set correctly
rationale: Logging hostnames may require reverse DNS lookups and can negatively impact connection performance.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_hostname = 'off';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure log_line_prefix is set correctly
rationale: Each log entry should contain sufficient contextual information to support auditing and troubleshooting.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] %q%u@%d ';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure log_statement is set correctly
rationale: Logging DDL statements provides an audit trail for schema changes.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_statement = 'ddl';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();

title: Ensure log_timezone is set correctly
rationale: Using UTC timestamps ensures consistency across distributed environments and simplifies log correlation.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET log_timezone = 'UTC';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();
